pr_title: feat(codgen): support positioned clicks in a canvas
pr_body:
Seems like its enough for now to only support clicks. Also thought about mouse down/up/move but seems not needed for now.

Fixes #6737
pr_comments: Any progress on this feature? We need this for testing applications with leaflet maps. Also, can this be applied to div elements?
It would be really handy if we had a feature like fixtures for the codegen tool. That way we could customise the page or browser contexts with all our desired functionality.
Hello @mxschmitt, may I please know how to use this feature in a codegen session?

> Hello @mxschmitt, may I please know how to use this feature in a codegen session?

Just click on a canvas and it should generate custom click statements with x and y included.

If something is not working I recommend filing a bug report.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Add a way to include x/y coordinates during codegen
comments: We also have the same case, our application is a whole canvas, and this will help a lot.

review_comments: I think we align `position` with `offsetX`, not `clientX`: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/master/packages/playwright-core/src/server/dom.ts#L308
